entities.summary: Jasper Weatherby is an American professional ice hockey forward who currently plays for Bílí Tygři Liberec of the Czech Extraliga (ELH). He was selected by the San Jose Sharks in the 2018 NHL Entry Draft and made his NHL debut in 2021.
